title: CARES: Coverage-Aware Replay Exemplar Selection for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Replay-based Continual Learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by keeping a buffer of past samples, making buffer composition critical under a fixed memory budget. Recent coreset-based replay methods improve buffer quality using model-derived gradients, losses, or auxiliary optimization, but incur substantial computational overhead as memory is repeatedly updated. We propose CARES, a continual model-optimization-free approach for buffer construction that instead exploits the geometry of a frozen pretrained feature space using class-aware, density-weighted coverage. We evaluate CARES across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy streams under online class- and task-incremental settings. On Tiny-ImageNet, CARES is 2.3 to 8.8 times faster than existing coreset-based selectors. Although CARES achieves this speedup using no training signal from the continual learner, it ranks among the state of the art across balanced, imbalanced, and label

translated_title: CARES：面向持续学习的覆盖感知回放样本选择
translated_abstract: 基于回放的持续学习通过保存过去样本的缓冲区来缓解灾难性遗忘，因此在固定内存预算下，缓冲区的构成至关重要。近期的基于核心集的回放方法利用模型衍生的梯度、损失或辅助优化来提升缓冲区质量，但由于内存需要反复更新，会带来大量计算开销。我们提出CARES，一种无需持续模型优化的缓冲区构建方法，它利用冻结的预训练特征空间的几何结构，采用类别感知、密度加权的覆盖度策略。我们在平衡、不平衡和标签噪声数据流下，于在线类增量与任务增量设置中对CARES进行了评估。在Tiny-ImageNet上，CARES比现有的基于核心集的选择器快2.3至8.8倍。尽管CARES在没有使用持续学习器任何训练信号的情况下实现了这一加速，但它在平衡、不平衡和标签噪声数据流中仍名列最先进水平。
tldr: CARES利用冻结预训练特征空间的类别感知、密度加权覆盖度来选择回放样本，无需任何模型优化即可构建缓冲区，比现有基于核心集的选择器快2.3至8.8倍，同时在平衡、不平衡和标签噪声数据流中保持最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: CARES selects replay exemplars via class-aware, density-weighted coverage of a frozen pretrained feature space, requiring no model optimization and running 2.3–8.8x faster than existing coreset-based selectors while remaining state of the art across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy streams.
